name: Ring of Obesity
body:
Aura faint conjuration; CL 5th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of sustenance and functions as such. Each day the ring is worn, however, the wearer gains one pound. This additional weight is counted against the character’s carrying capacity.

Casting remove curse on the wearer will allow the wearer to remove the ring, though the ring itself continues to function. Once removed, the character begins to lose the extra weight at the rate of two pounds per week until back to their normal weight.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of sustenance

Identification DC 30
False Identification DC 20
